rounds.title: Loader baseline
rounds.note: First drawing of the SDK loaders, drawn by their mock from @ethlete/components/design on the page: et-spinner (indeterminate sweep held at 30% of its cycle, optional track = the indicator at 24%, determinate arc), et-progress-bar (4px pill, track = the text colour at 12%, indeterminate held with both bars in view) and et-brand-loader (the 10rem E held at 55%: ghost, outline drawn, fill half swept). Spinner and bar inherit currentColor, or take --et-theme-color-primary-solid with color set; the brand loader accent defaults to primary-solid, the mint. Indicator against the page, light / dark: inherited 17.93 / 17.18; brand mint 1.33 / 13.50; danger 4.83 / 3.71; warning 3.19 / 5.63. Against its spinner track: inherited 10.64 / 8.04, brand 1.19 / 7.22, danger 3.30 / 3.04, warning 2.46 / 3.98 (track against the page 1.12-2.14). Against the progress track: inherited 13.99 / 12.24, brand 1.04 / 9.62, danger 3.77 / 2.65, warning 2.49 / 4.01 (track against the page 1.28 / 1.40). Brand loader: mint fill and outline 1.33:1 against the light page, 13.50 dark; ghost 1.46 / 1.80 against the page, mint on the ghost 1.10 light. So on light the mint spinner, bar and brand loader fail WCAG 1.4.11 (3:1). Q99 rule a applies (decided): b draws the brand spinner arc, the brand bar indicator and the brand loader outline in --et-theme-color-ink-solid, light 5.48:1 against the page, 3.87 against the spinner track, 4.28 against the bar track; the swept fill paints over the outline, so b adds a 0.7 ink edge on the mint fill, 4.13:1 against the fill. Dark: ink is the mint, so spinner and bar equal a; the added fill edge is mint on mint (1.00:1) and makes the E slightly bolder. That is Q102: c is b with the fill edge in light-dark(ink, transparent), dark as today. Q88 does not arise (no focus ring) and Q101 does not arise (no button). Q98, numbers only: the tracks above. Danger and warning keep their colour; warning light (3.19 page, 2.46 / 2.49 track) and danger dark against the bar track (2.65) are the weakest non-mint pairs.

a.note: Today: on light the brand mint is 1.33:1 against the page for the spinner arc, the bar indicator and the brand loader fill and outline; 1.19:1 against the spinner track, 1.04:1 against the bar track. Dark: 13.50:1 against the page, 7.22 / 9.62 against the tracks. Inherited 17.93 / 17.18.

b.note: Pick. Q99 rule a, decided: brand spinner arc, bar indicator and brand loader outline in ink: light 5.48:1 against the page, 3.87 against the spinner track, 4.28 against the bar track; the mint fill gets a 0.7 ink edge, 4.13:1 against the fill. Dark: ink is the mint, spinner and bar equal a; the fill edge is mint on mint (1.00:1), a slightly bolder E. Q102 open; if dark should stay as today, take c.

c.note: b with the fill edge in light-dark(ink, transparent): light equals b (5.48:1 against the page, 4.13:1 against the fill); dark is exactly today (shots identical to a). Keys on color-scheme, not on the surface; my reading of rule a, not a decided rule (Q102).
